title: Reference library index
description: Manifest for one reference-library layer (L1 skill-bundled, L2 user global, L3 patient-specific). The manifest is the sole authority: a file present in the directory but absent from `entries` is not a source. `trust_tier` is assigned by layer position and MUST NOT appear here.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp written by a build script, when the index is machine-generated.

generated_by.description: Script or process that wrote this index.

file.description: Path relative to the library root. Absolute paths, `..` segments and symlinks are rejected by library_resolve.py.

publisher.description: Issuing body as printed on the document. Self-declared; it never raises trust_tier.

version.description: Edition/version/batch string. Missing or placeholder values invalidate the entry.

date.description: Publication date of this version (ISO-8601 date or year).

retrieved_at.description: Date the user obtained the file. Deliberately separate from `date`.

lang.description: BCP-47-ish language tag, matched against profile.json locale during retrieval.

redistribution.description: Governs export eligibility. Only `allowed` may leave the machine; L1 accepts `allowed` only.

patient_scope.description: L2 accepts `general` only; anything patient-identifying belongs in L3.

expires_at.description: Optional explicit expiry. Past dates invalidate the entry.

source_url.description: Dataset entries: official page the data was compiled from.

latest_batch.description: Dataset entries: newest batch/release included in this snapshot.

record_count.description: Dataset entries: number of records in the file.

update_cadence.description: Dataset entries: declared refresh half-life. Required by the L1 maintenance contract.

build_script.description: Dataset entries: script that regenerates the file. L1 datasets without an update path are not admitted.
